Title: Azure Cosmos DB new shared database offer now available

Body.Content:
Throughput provisioned at the database level now starts at 400 RU/s per database and can be shared across any or all containers within a database. Throughput can be scaled in increments of 100 RU/s. Provisioning throughput at the database level can result in savings for databases with multiple containers, versus provisioning throughput to each container individually. Additionally, Azure Cosmos DB users as part of a complimentary Azure account can now use database provisioning as part of their 12-month trial. 

Learn more about throughput provisioned
